hints.title: Compute Total Spending per User
hints.text: Join the sales table with the product table on product id to calculate the revenue of each purchase.

hints.title: User Group Aggregation
hints.text: Aggregate by user id and sum quantity multiplied by product price.

hints.title: Deterministic Result Ordering
hints.text: Order the output records by spending in descending order, resolving ties by user id ascending.

hints.title: Group Sum and Ordering Implementation
hints.text:
```sql
select
    s.user_id,
    sum(s.quantity * p.price) as spending
from Sales s
join Product p on s.product_id = p.product_id
group by s.user_id
order by spending desc, s.user_id asc;
```

complexity.notes: Hash join and group by followed by sorting.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Correlated subquery per user causes repetitive scanning of the sales table.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Hash aggregate table accumulates totals in linear space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Demonstrates clear join, group by, and multi-column ordering.
